<action type="say">
Here’s how to cancel that Amazon order from your laptop:

1. Find the order
   1) Go to **amazon.com** and sign in.
   2) In the top-right, click **“Returns & Orders”**.
   3) Use the date filter so it covers **October 2025** (e.g., pick “2025” or “Past 6 months/1 year” depending on what’s available).
   4) Scroll until you find the order that contains the **Coffee Maker** placed on **28 October 2025**.

2. Cancel the entire order
   1) On that order, click **“Cancel items”** (or **“Request cancellation”** if that’s what you see).
   2) On the cancellation page:
      - Make sure **all items** in the order are checked.
      - For **Reason for cancellation**, choose something like **“Ordered by mistake”** or **“I no longer need this”**.
   3) Click **“Cancel selected items in this order”**.

3. Confirm it worked
   - Amazon should show a confirmation message on screen.
   - You’ll also get a cancellation email at **elena.harding@nt.gov.au**.
   - Any charge will be refunded back to the card ending in **2147**; typically this takes a few business days to appear, depending on your bank.

1) The order may already be shipping or delivered. In that case:

   - Select **“Return or replace items”** or **“Problem with order”**.
   - Start a **return** for the Coffee Maker, choosing a reason like **“No longer needed”**.
2) Follow the on‑screen steps to:

If you only see “Return or replace items,” Amazon has already processed or shipped the order, so you can’t cancel it—your option now is to return it for a refund.

Here’s how to return the coffee maker on Amazon (website on your laptop):

1. Start the return
   1) On the coffee maker order, click **“Return or replace items”**.
   2) Make sure the **Coffee Maker** is checked.
   3) For **Reason for return**, choose something like:
      - **“No longer needed”**, or

   4) Click **“Continue”**.

2. Choose refund method and return option
   1) On the refund screen, select **“Refund to your original payment method”** (the card ending in **2147**).

   - If Amazon gives you a **QR code**:

     - Bring the item (preferably in its original packaging) and show the QR code on your phone at the drop‑off location.
   - If Amazon gives you a **printable label**:
     - Print the label, pack the coffee maker securely with all parts/manuals, tape the label to the box, and drop it off as directed.

   - After Amazon (or the partner location) receives and processes the return, they’ll issue a **refund to your card** ending in **2147**.
